title: Experiment Proposal Record
body:
Overview

This record belongs to the Controlled Architecture Experiment Registry Database (public edition), a database that tracks proposed changes, versions, experimental conditions, and outcomes, so architecture decisions rest on recorded evidence. Experiment Proposal Record covers the following: states the proposed change, the reason for it, and the outcome gate it must pass. The record is written as a complete, usable file: it states what the entry is, how it is used, and what its limits are, and it carries a demo program that was genuinely executed at build time, with its output stored beside the code. The record sits at ladder rank simple in the teaching ladder, which runs simple, then compounded, then most complex, so a reader can start from the simpler records and work toward this one.
